channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: Southwestern Vermont's freight rail is getting a major upgrade with over sixty million dollars in federal funding. The project will replace old jointed tracks with continuous welded rail to boost safety and speed. This investment also lays groundwork for possible future passenger rail service in the region.

Police are looking for a driver who hit a pedestrian near an elementary school in West Fairlee Tuesday night. The driver and vehicle remain unidentified. Authorities urge anyone with information to come forward.

Bat populations in Essex County are rebounding after near collapse from white-nose syndrome. Scientists are tracking their survival and movements in the Barton Hill Mines. These bats play a vital role in controlling pests and supporting local ecosystems.

A longtime Killington town employee filed a police report after a heated confrontation with a Select Board member. The dispute centered on employee benefits and workplace treatment. Town leaders discussed the matter but have yet to take formal action.
